worldcombat.skill.morningsun.summary: Draws the clear daytime sun down onto itself: catching the morning light restores about two thirds of its missing health and grants a speed boost, while night or rain only restores a little and grants none.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.use.0: A strong heal under clear day
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.use.1: Trade the heal for a speed boost
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.description: Restores %1$s of the missing health: close to 2/3 under clear day, only the floor at night or in rain; more with higher Special Attack.
Settles after %1$s of greeting; catching the morning light also grants %2$s of movement speed, otherwise none.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of greeting it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
Below this health ratio the companion schedules Morning Sun; lower endures longer, higher greets the light at the first wound.
On: only cast in strong sunlight, holding the move at night or in rain (little heal, no boost). Off: cast whenever wounded and accept the floor heal.
